title: macOS solet setup
description: Reference setup contract derived from the current bootstrap, genesis, hydration profiles, plugin guidance, and verification surfaces. It is a design input for the wizard engine; entries marked adapter_required, proposed, or planned are not claims that the current setup path can execute them yet.

repository_checkout.title: Repository checkout
repository_checkout.description: The selected release must be present as a normal Git checkout so updates, provenance, and source inspection remain available.

python_runtime.title: Python runtime
python_runtime.description: Bootstrap and every generated hook must execute with Python 3.13 or newer, including fresh non-interactive shells.

durable_state.title: Durable state and vector search
durable_state.description: The installation needs PostgreSQL 17, a per-solet non-superuser role and database, SCRAM authentication, and pgvector.

embeddings.title: Embeddings
embeddings.description: Knowledge installation and retrieval require a selected embeddings implementation and a qualified model.

local_inference.title: Local inference
local_inference.description: Profiles that bind inference_service require a selected implementation and a model that passes structured-action qualification. The free profile may leave inference declared vacant.

coding_agent_integration.title: Coding-agent integration
coding_agent_integration.description: Every selected coding agent must be installed, authenticated independently, receive the repository plugin, and pass a fresh-session hook and PATH proof.

connector_configuration.title: Connector configuration timing
connector_configuration.description: Shipped plugins may be installed immediately while account credentials are configured now, on first use, or left dormant by explicit choice.

session_ingestion.title: Session-history ingestion
session_ingestion.description: Codex and Claude session sources are configured only after separate, explicit consent for their roots and must prove backfill plus retrieval.

resumability.title: Resumable execution
resumability.description: Every stage must checkpoint durable, non-secret progress and re-probe state before reapplying work.

setup_profile.title: Setup profile
setup_profile.prompt: Which starting capability set should this solet use?
setup_profile.description: Profiles provide reviewed defaults, but the final plan is the resolved set of requirements and options rather than a hidden preset.

free.label: Free local core
free.description: Local embeddings, no bound local inference service, and connectors left opt-in.

implications.cost: No required metered model service.
implications.privacy: Knowledge embeddings remain on the selected local implementation.
implications.security: Smallest default account and permission surface.
implications.operator_effort: Lowest setup burden.
implications.performance: Coding-agent sessions provide frontier reasoning; the platform inference slot remains vacant.

macos-bizops.label: Business operations
macos-bizops.description: Adds local inference, fleet and deployment tooling, and business connectors while leaving account authorization selectable.

implications.cost: Local model execution has no per-call fee but requires more hardware and operator time.
implications.privacy: Local inference is available; selected external connectors transmit data to their vendors.
implications.security: Broader connector and deployment permission surface that must be reviewed explicitly.
implications.operator_effort: Higher because external accounts and RBAC must be prepared.
implications.performance: Supports platform inference and parallel fleet work.

custom.label: Custom
custom.description: Select every optional capability and implementation explicitly.

implications.cost: Depends on selected components and accounts.
implications.privacy: Depends on selected local and external services.
implications.security: The review page becomes the authoritative effective permission surface.
implications.operator_effort: Highest because fewer defaults are applied.
implications.performance: Can be tuned to the host and workload.

embeddings_implementation.title: Embeddings implementation
embeddings_implementation.description: An option may reuse the current OpenAI-compatible plugin or activate a different plugin entirely.

implications.cost: No per-call fee; consumes local compute.
implications.privacy: Embedding text remains local.
implications.security: Local HTTP service should remain bound to a trusted interface.
implications.operator_effort: Install the app, start its server, and load an embedding model.
implications.performance: Depends on selected model and hardware.

ollama_plugin.label: Ollama plugin
ollama_plugin.description: Example alternative that may activate a dedicated plugin instead of sharing the current implementation.

implications.cost: No per-call fee; consumes local compute.
implications.privacy: Embedding text remains local.
implications.security: Local service exposure must be reviewed.
implications.operator_effort: Requires the future plugin and its own install/configuration flow.
implications.performance: Depends on selected model and hardware.

embedding_model.title: Embedding model
embedding_model.prompt: Which discovered embedding model should be used?
embedding_model.description: The wizard discovers models from the selected implementation, displays metadata and recommendations, then qualifies the chosen model with a real embedding request.

inference_implementation.title: Inference implementation
inference_implementation.prompt: Should the platform bind a local inference service, and which implementation should own it?
inference_implementation.description: Selecting none is valid for the free profile. Other options may activate different plugins and model qualification rules.

none.label: Leave inference vacant
none.description: Use selected coding-agent sessions as the frontier driver and do not load a platform inference plugin.

implications.cost: No local inference setup or metered platform model cost.
implications.privacy: Platform does not send autonomous inference requests.
implications.security: Smallest inference attack surface.
implications.operator_effort: No inference model to install.
implications.performance: Autonomous flows requiring inference_service remain unavailable.

implications.cost: No per-call fee; significant local compute and memory may be required.
implications.privacy: Prompts remain local.
implications.security: Local HTTP service and model downloads must be trusted.
implications.operator_effort: Load and keep a compatible model available.
implications.performance: Depends heavily on model, context size, and hardware.

alternative_plugin.label: Alternative inference plugin
alternative_plugin.description: Extension point for an implementation with its own plugin, dependencies, auth, and qualification probes.

implications.cost: Implementation-specific.
implications.privacy: Implementation-specific.
implications.security: Implementation-specific and must be reviewed before activation.
implications.operator_effort: Requires a shipped plugin contract.

inference_model.title: Inference model
inference_model.prompt: Which discovered inference model should the platform use?
inference_model.description: Model choice is not a free-text afterthought: the wizard discovers candidates, shows context and resource facts, then tests structured output and representative actions.

coding_agents.title: Coding agents
coding_agents.prompt: Which coding-agent clients should be installed and integrated on consent?
coding_agents.description: Claude Code and Codex are independent consented installations with independent plugin installation, hook behavior, and fresh-session verification.

codex.label: Codex
codex.description: Install the Codex CLI on consent when absent, then verify its repository plugin, hooks, launcher, and receive path.

implications.cost: Uses the operator's Codex plan or API entitlement.
implications.privacy: Repository context and prompts follow the selected Codex account policy.
implications.security: Existing Codex auth remains owned by the Codex client; the setup journal stores no token.
implications.operator_effort: Requires an installed Codex CLI and a fresh-session proof.
implications.performance: Model and effort can be selected per fleet dispatch.

claude_code.label: Claude Code
claude_code.description: Install the Claude Code CLI on consent when absent, then verify its marketplace plugin, hooks, launcher, and receive path.

implications.cost: Uses the operator's Claude plan or API entitlement.
implications.privacy: Repository context and prompts follow the selected Claude account policy.
implications.security: Existing Claude auth remains owned by the Claude client; the setup journal stores no token.
implications.operator_effort: Requires an installed Claude CLI and a fresh-session proof.
implications.performance: Model and effort can be selected per fleet dispatch.

execution_topology.title: Execution topology
execution_topology.prompt: Should this setup support a single driving session or a managed fleet?
execution_topology.description: Fleet mode adds tmux, messaging identity, model/effort/TTL dispatch controls, and durable role verification.

solo.label: Solo
solo.description: One driving coding-agent session with no managed worker requirement.

implications.cost: Lowest concurrent model usage.
implications.privacy: No additional worker sessions.
implications.security: Smallest messaging and role surface.
implications.operator_effort: Simplest operating model.
implications.performance: Parallel work must be done sequentially.

fleet.label: Managed fleet
fleet.description: Enable explicit model, effort, work class, TTL, role, and lifecycle controls for additional sessions.

implications.cost: Concurrent sessions can spend more tokens; model, effort, and TTL must be explicit per dispatch.
implications.privacy: Task briefs and peer messages are persisted in fleet state.
implications.security: Role ownership and Git-Controller boundaries become load-bearing.
implications.operator_effort: Requires tmux and lifecycle monitoring.
implications.performance: Parallel review and implementation lanes reduce elapsed time.

git_mutation_control.title: Git mutation control
git_mutation_control.prompt: How should Git mutations be controlled in this deployment?
git_mutation_control.description: Choose a single-session exemption or designate one controller role; ask explicitly in both topologies.

single_session.label: Single session
single_session.description: Do not export a controller name; the Git-mutation gate remains unarmed.

implications.cost: No additional controller session is required.
implications.privacy: No additional Git-controller identity is exported to workers.
implications.security: The narrow single-session exemption leaves the mutation gate unarmed.
implications.operator_effort: Git work stays in the one operator-controlled session.
implications.performance: Git-mutating work cannot be delegated safely to a fleet worker.

designated_controller.label: Designated controller
designated_controller.description: Export one named Git controller to arm the shared-checkout mutation gate.

implications.cost: A dedicated controller session is needed for Git mutations.
implications.privacy: The controller role name is propagated to managed workers.
implications.security: The mutation gate blocks non-controller workers in the shared checkout.
implications.operator_effort: The controller must be provisioned before it can land work.
implications.performance: Implementation can proceed in parallel while Git mutation remains serialized.

autostart.title: Background startup
autostart.prompt: Should the solet run as a per-user LaunchAgent after login?
autostart.description: Autostart is a separate system-change decision and requires explicit review of the generated service definition.

enabled.label: Enable autostart
enabled.description: Install the per-user LaunchAgent and verify a post-login service start.

implications.cost: Background resource use while the service is running.
implications.privacy: No additional data access by itself.
implications.security: Creates a persistent background item with an explicit executable and PATH.
implications.operator_effort: Least manual startup work after setup.

disabled.label: Manual start
disabled.description: Do not install a background item; provide the foreground start command in the completion report.

implications.cost: No background resource use until manually started.
implications.privacy: No additional data access.
implications.security: No persistent background item.
implications.operator_effort: Requires manual start and restart.

connector_configuration_timing.title: Connector configuration
connector_configuration_timing.prompt: When should optional external connectors request account access?
connector_configuration_timing.description: Installation and authorization are separate. The current recommendation installs shipped plugin code now and requests credentials only when the user chooses to configure or first uses a connector.

first_use.label: Configure on first use
first_use.description: Install shipped plugin code now; leave connectors visibly dormant until selected.

implications.cost: No account setup time for unused connectors.
implications.privacy: No external account access until chosen.
implications.security: Minimizes standing credentials.
implications.operator_effort: Defers work and may interrupt the first connector task.

configure_now.label: Configure selected connectors now
configure_now.description: Choose connectors in the next page and complete their account-specific flows during setup.

implications.cost: Longer initial setup and possible vendor costs.
implications.privacy: Selected accounts become accessible immediately.
implications.security: Credentials and RBAC must be reviewed now.
implications.operator_effort: More work now, less interruption later.
implications.performance: Selected connectors are ready at completion.

connectors_to_configure.title: Connectors to configure
connectors_to_configure.prompt: Which external connectors should be authorized now?
connectors_to_configure.description: Every selection activates its own plugin-specific input, authentication, consent, RBAC, and live verification flow.

google_workspace.label: Google Workspace
google_workspace.description: OAuth access to Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides.

implications.cost: Uses the selected Google account and project quotas.
implications.privacy: Broad workspace content may be read and modified within granted scopes.
implications.security: Five OAuth scopes and the redirect mode require explicit review.
implications.operator_effort: Create an OAuth app and complete browser authorization.

jira.label: Jira
jira.description: API-token access to Jira with read, write, and permanent-delete capability.

implications.cost: Uses the selected Jira account and plan.
implications.privacy: Project, issue, and user data become readable.
implications.security: The token inherits the user's permissions and destructive delete exists.
implications.operator_effort: Create and rotate an API token.

marketo.label: Marketo
marketo.description: OAuth client-credentials access from a LaunchPoint service.

implications.cost: Uses Marketo API quota.
implications.privacy: Marketing assets and person data may be accessible.
implications.security: Delete and merge capabilities require a least-privilege API role.
implications.operator_effort: Create API Role, API User, and LaunchPoint service.

salesforce.label: Salesforce
salesforce.description: Consent-provisioned Salesforce CLI browser login owned by the CLI and macOS Keychain.

implications.cost: Uses Salesforce account and API limits.
implications.privacy: Org data within the authenticated user's permissions becomes available.
implications.security: The Salesforce CLI owns the credential; setup records only alias and instance host.
implications.operator_effort: Approve the reviewed sf provisioning action and complete browser login.

schwab.label: Schwab market data
schwab.description: Browser OAuth with a registered HTTPS callback replayed to a local listener.

implications.cost: Uses a Schwab developer application.
implications.privacy: Market-data account context participates in authorization.
implications.security: Callback handling and client-secret storage require special care.
implications.operator_effort: Create the app and reauthorize approximately weekly.

snowflake.label: Snowflake
snowflake.description: RSA key-pair authentication with an operator-selected user and role.

implications.cost: Queries consume Snowflake credits.
implications.privacy: Data visible to the configured role becomes readable.
implications.security: The selected role is the write boundary; run_statement can mutate data.
implications.operator_effort: Generate and attach a 4096-bit RSA key and configure least privilege.

zuora.label: Zuora
zuora.description: OAuth client-credentials access to a selected environment.

implications.cost: Uses the selected Zuora tenant and API quota.
implications.privacy: Billing and subscription data become accessible.
implications.security: Client secret is vaulted; environment selection must be verified.
implications.operator_effort: Create an OAuth client and select the correct tenant.

external_postgres.label: External PostgreSQL
external_postgres.description: Add zero or more on-demand database connections with separate least-privilege credentials.

implications.cost: Uses the external database service.
implications.privacy: Rows visible to each configured database role become accessible.
implications.security: Each database role and grants are the write boundary.
implications.operator_effort: Prepare one credential set per connection.

session_sources.title: Session sources
session_sources.prompt: Which local coding-agent histories may this solet index?
session_sources.description: Each selected source asks separately for its exact roots and proves registration, backfill, and retrieval. Declining leaves local history untouched and unindexed.

codex_local.label: Codex local sessions
codex_local.description: Index the approved Codex sessions and archived-sessions roots without moving or deleting them.

implications.cost: Embedding the initial backfill consumes local model time.
implications.privacy: Full local Codex session content becomes searchable inside the solet.
implications.security: Access is limited to user-approved roots and requires Files and Folders permission where macOS enforces it.
implications.operator_effort: Approve roots, restart once, backfill, and verify retrieval.

claude_local.label: Claude Code local sessions
claude_local.description: Index the approved Claude projects, history, and tasks roots without moving or deleting them.

implications.cost: Embedding the initial backfill consumes local model time.
implications.privacy: Full local Claude session content becomes searchable inside the solet.
implications.security: Access is limited to user-approved roots and requires Files and Folders permission where macOS enforces it.
implications.operator_effort: Approve roots, restart once, backfill, and verify retrieval.

homebrew.name: Homebrew
homebrew.description: Recommended macOS package manager for PostgreSQL, pgvector, tmux, and supporting tools.

postgresql_17.name: PostgreSQL 17
postgresql_17.description: Local state store with per-solet role, database, schema, SCRAM policy, and pgvector.

lm_studio.name: LM Studio
lm_studio.description: Current recommended local host for OpenAI-compatible embeddings and platform inference. User-managed: the wizard discovers models already loaded in LM Studio and blocks if none are found — it does not download or load models. The model name in the profile config is the SERVE-TIME key, which LM Studio derives from the download source and which cannot be used to find it: fetch with `lms get "https://huggingface.co/<owner>/<repo>" --yes` (the bare owner/repo shorthand fails) and the config's key follows automatically. The per-model map is in profile_templates/lm_studio_models.yaml.

ollama.name: Ollama
ollama.description: Example alternative model host. The flow may activate dedicated future plugins rather than assuming shared implementation.

codex_cli.name: Codex CLI
codex_cli.description: Consent-provisioned Codex client with repository plugin support.

claude_cli.name: Claude Code CLI
claude_cli.description: Consent-provisioned Claude Code client with repository marketplace plugin support.

node_runtime.name: Node.js runtime
node_runtime.description: Required for selected Codex hook behavior.

tmux.name: tmux
tmux.description: Swap-durable host for managed fleet sessions.

macos_keychain.name: macOS Keychain
macos_keychain.description: Local credential store and auth-session owner for secrets that must remain outside the repository and journal.

git_checkout.name: Git checkout
git_checkout.description: A checkout containing the selected repository revision and its tracked setup artifacts.

python_313.name: Python 3.13 or newer
python_313.description: Required by bootstrap, platform code, and generated hooks.

homebrew_command.name: Homebrew command
homebrew_command.description: Homebrew must exist before package-managed dependencies can be installed.

pgvector_package.name: pgvector
pgvector_package.description: Vector extension for the local PostgreSQL installation.

tmux_command.name: tmux
tmux_command.description: Required only when the managed fleet topology is selected.

node_runtime.name: Node.js runtime
node_runtime.description: Required only when Codex is selected.

salesforce_cli.name: Salesforce sf CLI
salesforce_cli.description: Homebrew formula Salesforce CLI with declared Node closure; the absolute executable path is recorded as non-secret configuration.

repository_ref.label: Repository release
repository_ref.description: Git tag, branch, or immutable revision selected for installation.

solet_name.label: Solet name
solet_name.description: Lowercase installation name used for profile, database, launcher, and runtime paths.

clone_directory.label: Checkout directory
clone_directory.description: Absolute path to the repository checkout.

setup_journal_path.label: Setup journal path
setup_journal_path.description: Per-installation durable progress record outside the repository and protected session-history paths.

git_controller_name.label: Git controller role name
git_controller_name.description: The one role allowed to mutate Git in this deployment when designated-controller mode is chosen.

lm_studio_base_url.label: LM Studio base URL
lm_studio_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible local endpoint for the selected LM Studio services.

ollama_base_url.label: Ollama base URL
ollama_base_url.description: Endpoint used by the future Ollama plugin option.

google_oauth_client_id.label: Google OAuth client ID
google_oauth_client_id.description: Public client identifier for the selected Google OAuth application.

google_oauth_client_secret.label: Google OAuth client secret
google_oauth_client_secret.description: Secret for the selected Google OAuth application.

jira_base_url.label: Jira base URL
jira_base_url.description: Base URL of the Jira Cloud or Server instance.

jira_email.label: Jira account email
jira_email.description: Account identity paired with the API token.

jira_api_token.label: Jira API token
jira_api_token.description: Token inheriting the selected Jira user's permissions.

salesforce_alias.label: Salesforce org alias
salesforce_alias.description: Local alias owned by the Salesforce CLI.

salesforce_instance_url.label: Salesforce instance URL
salesforce_instance_url.description: Login or My Domain URL for the target org.

schwab_callback_url.label: Schwab registered callback URL
schwab_callback_url.description: HTTPS callback registered with Schwab and replayed to the local listener by the auth flow.

snowflake_user.label: Snowflake user
snowflake_user.description: User to which the public key is attached.

snowflake_role.label: Snowflake role
snowflake_role.description: Least-privilege role that defines the plugin's read/write boundary.

snowflake_private_key.label: Snowflake RSA private key
snowflake_private_key.description: 4096-bit private key whose public counterpart is attached to the Snowflake user.

zuora_base_url.label: Zuora environment URL
zuora_base_url.description: Base URL that identifies the target tenant environment.

external_postgres_name.label: Connection name
external_postgres_name.description: Unique local name for an external PostgreSQL connection.

external_postgres_password.label: Database password
external_postgres_password.description: Password for the least-privilege external PostgreSQL role.

google_workspace_oauth.name: Google Workspace OAuth
google_workspace_oauth.description: Browser OAuth for Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides using a local loopback or web callback selected by deployment topology.

jira_api_token.name: Jira API token
jira_api_token.description: Jira account email plus API token; no OAuth callback.
security_notes: The token inherits the user's Jira permissions.
Permanent issue deletion is available and requires separate destructive-action consent.

marketo_client_credentials.name: Marketo LaunchPoint credentials
marketo_client_credentials.description: OAuth client-credentials flow backed by a Marketo API Role, API User, and LaunchPoint service.

salesforce_cli_login.name: Salesforce CLI browser login
salesforce_cli_login.description: The standalone sf CLI performs browser login and owns the resulting credential in its auth store or macOS Keychain.

schwab_oauth.name: Schwab browser OAuth
schwab_oauth.description: Browser OAuth using a registered HTTPS callback whose final redirect is replayed to the local HTTP listener.

snowflake_rsa.name: Snowflake RSA key pair
snowflake_rsa.description: 4096-bit RSA key-pair authentication; the selected user and role define the effective authorization boundary.
external_prerequisites: Snowflake user with RSA public key

zuora_client_credentials.name: Zuora OAuth client credentials
zuora_client_credentials.description: OAuth client-credentials flow scoped to the tenant selected by base URL.

external_postgres_credentials.name: External PostgreSQL credentials
external_postgres_credentials.description: Repeatable on-demand connection credentials; zero configured connections is a normal steady state.

system_change_consent.title: Install system dependencies
system_change_consent.prompt: Review and authorize the exact package, service, database-role, and filesystem changes in the generated plan.
scope: Homebrew packages selected by the plan
Per-solet database, role, schema, and SCRAM policy

decline.consequence: Setup remains at the reviewed-plan checkpoint and performs no system mutation.

shell_modification_consent.title: Install shell integration
shell_modification_consent.prompt: Authorize the reviewed PATH and launcher block in the selected shell startup file.

decline.consequence: The installation cannot claim fresh-shell command or hook readiness.

background_service_consent.title: Run after login
background_service_consent.prompt: Authorize the reviewed per-user LaunchAgent and background item.

decline.consequence: The solet remains manual-start only.

codex_session_ingestion_consent.title: Index Codex session history
codex_session_ingestion_consent.prompt: Authorize read-only ingestion of the displayed Codex session and archived-session roots. No source files will be moved, deleted, or modified.

decline.consequence: Codex history remains local and unindexed.

claude_session_ingestion_consent.title: Index Claude Code session history
claude_session_ingestion_consent.prompt: Authorize read-only ingestion of the displayed Claude projects, history, and tasks roots. No source files will be moved, deleted, or modified.

decline.consequence: Claude history remains local and unindexed.

google_workspace_account_consent.title: Authorize Google Workspace account
google_workspace_account_consent.prompt: Review the five requested Google scopes and authorize the selected account.

decline.consequence: Google Workspace remains not connected.

jira_destructive_access_consent.title: Authorize Jira write and delete capability
jira_destructive_access_consent.prompt: Acknowledge that the Jira token inherits user permissions and the plugin includes permanent deletion.

decline.consequence: Jira remains not connected.

marketo_destructive_access_consent.title: Authorize Marketo write, delete, and merge capability
marketo_destructive_access_consent.prompt: Review the selected Marketo API Role and acknowledge delete and merge capabilities.

decline.consequence: Marketo remains not connected.

snowflake_write_access_consent.title: Authorize Snowflake role
snowflake_write_access_consent.prompt: Review the selected Snowflake role and acknowledge that run_statement can write wherever that role permits.
scope: All objects visible to the configured role
Statement execution permitted by the role

decline.consequence: Snowflake remains not connected.

background_items_permission.name: Background items
background_items_permission.purpose: Allow the reviewed per-user LaunchAgent to run after login.

codex_session_files_permission.name: Codex session files
codex_session_files_permission.purpose: Read only the user-approved Codex session roots for ingestion.

claude_session_files_permission.name: Claude Code session files
claude_session_files_permission.purpose: Read only the user-approved Claude projects, history, and tasks roots for ingestion.

keychain_permission.name: macOS Keychain
keychain_permission.purpose: Store the platform vault passphrase and provider-owned client sessions without placing secrets in the repository.

github_midwife_plugin.name: GitHub midwife
github_midwife_plugin.description: Birth-spine owner of bootstrap handoff, genesis, profile materialization, launchers, and hydration guidance.

access_posture.rbac_boundary: Local user account and explicit setup consents.

decline.consequence: The repository cannot complete genesis without its birth spine.

macos_vault_plugin.name: macOS vault
macos_vault_plugin.description: Agent-blind credential broker backed by macOS Keychain.

access_posture.rbac_boundary: The logged-in user's Keychain access controls.

decline.consequence: Secret-bearing plugins cannot be configured safely.

postgres_state_management_plugin.name: PostgreSQL state management
postgres_state_management_plugin.description: Durable platform state through the StateManagementInterface.

access_posture.rbac_boundary: Per-solet non-superuser PostgreSQL role and schema.

decline.consequence: Core platform state is unavailable.

pgvector_service_plugin.name: pgvector service
pgvector_service_plugin.description: Vector indexing and search over the local PostgreSQL database.

access_posture.rbac_boundary: Per-solet PostgreSQL schema.

decline.consequence: Knowledge retrieval cannot meet the current profile contract.

openai_embeddings_plugin.name: OpenAI-compatible embeddings
openai_embeddings_plugin.description: Current embeddings plugin used by the shipped profiles.

access_posture.rbac_boundary: Configured embedding endpoint.

decline.consequence: A different embeddings implementation must be selected.

ollama_embeddings_plugin.name: Ollama embeddings
ollama_embeddings_plugin.description: Planned example of an alternative embeddings implementation with its own plugin contract.

access_posture.rbac_boundary: Future plugin contract.

decline.consequence: Choose a supported implementation.

access_posture.rbac_boundary: Configured local inference endpoint.

decline.consequence: inference_service remains declared vacant.

alternative_inference_plugin.name: Alternative inference
alternative_inference_plugin.description: Planned extension point for another inference implementation.

access_posture.rbac_boundary: Future plugin contract.

decline.consequence: Choose a supported implementation or leave inference vacant.

agent_messaging_plugin.name: Agent messaging
agent_messaging_plugin.description: Identity, peer delivery, durable roles, managed fleet lifecycle, and session telemetry.

access_posture.rbac_boundary: Durable role bindings and explicit fleet dispatch.

decline.consequence: The selected coding-agent integration cannot meet the coordination contract.

macos_self_deployment_plugin.name: macOS self deployment
macos_self_deployment_plugin.description: Router-mediated blue-green release management for selected profiles.

access_posture.rbac_boundary: Local release directories and router socket.

decline.consequence: Updates require a non-blue-green operating procedure.

platform_dev_surface_plugin.name: Platform development surface
platform_dev_surface_plugin.description: Read-only repository and quality-gate operations for selected development profiles.

access_posture.rbac_boundary: Confined read-only repository root.

decline.consequence: Live repository and gate verbs are unavailable.

codex_filesystem_session_source_plugin.name: Codex filesystem session source
codex_filesystem_session_source_plugin.description: Read-only ingestion from user-approved local Codex session roots.

access_posture.rbac_boundary: Exact user-approved local roots.

known_gaps.summary: All 54 declared probe expectation values are advisory documentation and are not evaluated against observed probe values.
known_gaps.impact: Doctor reports probe checkpoint status from the probe implementation; expectation declarations do not independently validate or block that status.

known_gaps.summary: Generated and shipped hook surfaces have historically relied on ambient python3 resolution.
known_gaps.impact: A plugin may appear installed while its hooks are inert under an older system Python.

known_gaps.summary: Only a minority of shipped plugins currently provide structured hydration guidance.
known_gaps.impact: The wizard cannot infer missing auth, permission, and maintenance requirements safely; undocumented plugins must remain explicitly marked partial, implicit, or missing.

known_gaps.summary: Current profiles hard-code model identifiers rather than discovering and qualifying selectable models. Separately, a hard-coded identifier is a serve-time API alias and not necessarily a downloadable catalog name, so it cannot be used to acquire the model it names.
known_gaps.impact: Changing a model is an undocumented config edit and readiness may accept an endpoint without proving representative behavior.
